title: Surprise regulatory fine on bank reputation and stock value
research_question: Does a surprise regulatory fine announcement generate negative abnormal returns beyond the direct financial cost (fine amount / market cap), suggesting reputational damage?
data_description: Event study data for 80 banks. Variables: stock_id, event_day (−10 to +10), ret, mkt_ret, beta, fine_ratio (fine/mktcap). Evaluate if CAR < −fine_ratio, implying reputational loss beyond the fine itself. Market model: [−10,−2]. Event window [−1,+1].
